subject: VIP reception catering — PO ceiling, invoice timing, and sponsor reimbursement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Catering ask for VIP reception — need PO ceiling and invoice timing

Hi team,

We just confirmed the VIP reception for our ACME customer dinner at SouthBay on Aug 12. Venue confirmed a 150-person capacity but we'll plan for 80 guests. Before I sign the catering SOW I need two things from finance and events ops:

- PO ceiling (total not-to-exceed) we should issue to the caterer
- Standard invoice schedule (deposit %, final invoice payment terms) so I can align with their contract

Budget target for catering line is $9k but ACME has indicated they will reimburse up to $4k as sponsor credit — need to confirm how that will be handled (vendor invoice vs. sponsor reimbursement).

Attaching the proposed menu from Citrus (they recommended a passed hors d'oeuvres setup and two food stations). Want to move quickly because venue needs vendor names for insurance by next week.

Thanks,
Marissa
---
Marissa Cole
Sr. Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198
From: Citrus Catering <contracts@citruscatering.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: events@southbayhotel.com
Date: 2026-07-20T09:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catering ask for VIP reception — need PO ceiling and invoice timing

Hi Marissa / Mina,

Thanks for the details — sending our suggested menu and a sample payment schedule (attached: Citrus_Menu_v3.pdf). Key points: 

- Standard deposit: 50% of estimated total to secure date and staffing.
- Final invoice: issued within 48 hours of event; payable net 30.
- If guest count changes >10% within 7 days of event, we do a final reconciliation invoice.
- Insurance certificate and W9 will be provided after PO is received.

Estimated cost for 80 guests with passed hors d'oeuvres + 2 stations + staffing: $8,750. If ACME covers $4,000 directly to Redwood, we can invoice Redwood for the remaining balance. If Redwood prefers, we can invoice ACME for the sponsor portion but we'd need their billing contact and to be added to the venue insurance addendum.

We can also split invoices (deposit to Redwood; final balance net 30 with credit memo once sponsor payment clears). Let me know which route works and we will draft a PO-ready invoice.

— Julia Park
Contracts Manager, Citrus Catering
contracts@citruscatering.com
Attachment: Citrus_Menu_v3.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-21T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catering ask for VIP reception — need PO ceiling and invoice timing

Thanks for the context. A few notes from finance: 

- We can approve a PO up to $10,000 for this event (cost center and spend cap). Please confirm final estimated total by EOD Friday so I can issue the PO.
- Cost center for field marketing events is 4021-EMKT. Use project code: EMKT-ACME-0826.
- Preferred flow for sponsor credits: Redwood receives full invoice; Redwood applies sponsor reimbursement once we receive a signed reimbursement agreement or payment remittance directly from ACME. We will not issue split invoices to external vendors unless vendor has established billing relationship with the sponsor.

Action items for Marissa/Mina: confirm headcount estimate and authorize the $10k PO ceiling if acceptable.

Ben
Ben Carter
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, contracts@citruscatering.com
Date: 2026-07-22T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catering ask for VIP reception — need PO ceiling and invoice timing

Thanks Ben — confirming on headcount. Marissa: we plan for 80 as the safe estimate; expect final ~72–84 range. Marissa, if you confirm 80 I will approve the $10k PO ceiling.

I attached a PO draft (PO_draft_0722.pdf) with cost center 4021-EMKT and project code EMKT-ACME-0826. Draft includes: 50% deposit to Citrus on PO issuance; final balance net 30 to Redwood. Post-event, finance will reconcile the final invoice against the PO and apply sponsor reimbursement once we receive payment remittance from ACME.

I am also pasting a DocuSign link for approvals to speed this up. Lauren — can you confirm the venue insurance addendum will allow vendor billing to Redwood only? If venue insists on the sponsor being on the certificate we can handle an addendum but need to know early.

Thanks,
Mina

Subject: Re: VIP reception catering — PO ceiling, invoice timing, and sponsor reimbursement

Hi Mina / Marissa,

ACME confirms we will reimburse Redwood up to $4,000 for catering on this event. Our procurement team needs Redwood to send an itemized final invoice showing the total and the amount Redwood is seeking as reimbursement. Payment will be issued within 30 days of invoice receipt.

For insurance/cert: ACME does not need to be listed on vendor insurance. We will issue the reimbursement directly to Redwood via ACH once we receive Redwood's invoice. Please include the following on the invoice to match our AP system: ACME Inc. — Attn: Accounts Payable; Invoice ref: ACME-REDWOOD-0826.

Also confirming sponsor asks: company logo on one table sign and logo included on the event slide deck (digital) — fine with us.

Thanks — looking forward to the event.
Karen Li
Senior Events Lead, ACME Inc.
karen.li@acmeinc.com

Thanks Karen — that works. We will issue the PO to Citrus for a ceiling of $10,000 (cost center 4021-EMKT, project EMKT-ACME-0826).
